scope: Complete compare_artifacts CPU byte-selection entry for a unique localized single-line change; exact packet equivalence on broad cases; no token-counter, model, cash, GPU, or end-to-end claim.

verifier.method: frozen-baseline source review, independent packet/applicator differential, guard-call checks, paired timing, manifest hash readback, focused and full regression

limitations: The speed measurement uses one synthetic repeated-line CPU workload and does not estimate a population mean for real artifacts.
Token-counter selection intentionally retains the original matcher and has no speedup claim.
No model quality, provider token, cash cost, GPU, network, or end-to-end Agent latency was measured.
The full repository has two pre-existing knowledge/plugin generated-reference failures, so the repository is not claimed fully green.

implementation.reason: Independent source inspection confirmed the guard only skips SequenceMatcher for byte selection when each side changes by at most one line absent from the opposite text; token-counter and reuse/multiline cases retain the original matcher.

reference_boundary.reason: Independent baseline comparison covered 3,016 empty, CRLF, Unicode, repeated, insertion/deletion/replacement, prior-failure, 2,048-line and 65,536-character cases in two modes: 6,032 packets matched byte-for-byte and independently restored.

data_integrity.reason: All eight manifest references and the validation plan matched their frozen hashes; seed, case counts, code revision and seven paired samples were present and consistent.

numerical_sanity.reason: The seven producer samples were finite and nonnegative; independent median/reduction recomputation exactly matched the frozen measurement and manifest.

measurement_validity.reason: After warmup, seven alternating-order complete-entry pairs gave an independent median reduction from 632.832658 ms to 1.809249 ms; packet equivalence and restoration held, comfortably exceeding the predeclared 50% threshold.

reproducibility.reason: A separate read-only verifier reran the frozen baseline/candidate differential and 23 focused tests. The 1,174-test full suite retained only two unrelated baseline failures.
